title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive Poole Permanent, Full-time Up to £38,000

You ll own the digital presence of two growing brands in the sports space, across both B2 B and B2 C audiences.
From paid campaigns to SEO and content, your ideas and analysis will directly shape how the business grows.
This is a role for someone who loves testing, learning and turning data into real commercial results.

As a Digital Marketing Executive, you will benefit from:
- Hybrid working from a Poole office base
- Genuine ownership of digital activity across two brands
- Direct reporting line to the Head of Marketing, with support and visibility
- The chance to explore new channels, tools and AI-led search opportunities
- A permanent, full-time role in a business with clear growth ambitions

As a Digital Marketing Executive, your responsibilities will include:
- Planning, running and optimising Meta and Google Ads campaigns, from audience and creative to landing pages and conversion
- Managing both websites and leading SEO, AEO and GEO activity to grow visibility across search and AI platforms
- Using HubSpot for landing pages, lead tracking, email marketing, automation and reporting
- Managing social media, content calendars and copy for social, email, web, blogs and case studies
- Planning digital activity around events, product launches and key commercial moments
- Analysing performance and budgets to make data-led recommendations that improve ROI

As a Digital Marketing Executive, your experience will include:
- 3+ years in digital marketing, ideally across B2 B and B2 C
- Proven PPC experience on Meta and Google Ads
- Strong skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Premiere Pro)
- Solid SEO, GEO and AEO knowledge with a record of improving rankings
- Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting performance data
- Desirable: HubSpot experience, a Bachelor s degree in Marketing or similar, CRO/UX awareness, photo and video skills, and a passion for sports, especially football

If you re a Digital Marketing Executive ready to make your mark on two brands and see the impact of your work every week, this is the next step for you. Apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Nina Cranidge at Rubicon for more information.

While Rubicon uses AI to help speed up processes across the business, every application is reviewed by a human to ensure the right decision is made.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Digital Marketing Specialist to join the marketing team of a growing sports technology business.

Working across two complementary brands, you'll play a key role in developing and delivering digital marketing activity across both B2 B and B2 C audiences. You'll be responsible for using digital channels to increase brand visibility, generate high-quality leads and support wider commercial growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining creative marketing with data, performance and technology - from paid advertising and SEO through to content, social media, websites and marketing automation.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

Digital Campaigns & Performance
- Plan, execute and optimise Meta and Google Ads campaigns, from audience targeting and creative through to landing pages, lead capture and conversion.
- Develop and manage campaigns around products, launches, events and key commercial moments.
- Build and optimise landing pages and campaign journeys using HubSpot.
- Monitor campaign performance, budgets, conversions and ROI, making data-led recommendations to continually improve results.
- Identify opportunities to increase lead generation, conversion rates and overall digital performance.

Website, SEO & Digital Platforms
- Manage and maintain the company's websites, including content updates, landing pages and conversion opportunities.
- Lead SEO, AEO and GEO activity to improve visibility across search engines and AI-powered platforms.
- Use HubSpot for campaign management, lead tracking, email marketing, automation and reporting.
- Analyse website, campaign, email and social performance to identify opportunities and measure commercial impact.

Social Media & Content
- Manage the digital presence across relevant social channels, including social media planning, content calendars and publishing.
- Work closely with the Content Specialist to ensure content supports wider campaigns and commercial objectives.
- Write engaging copy for social media, email, websites, landing pages and digital campaigns, as well as blogs, articles and customer case studies.
- Coordinate photography, video and creative assets, supporting content creation where required.

Campaign & Event Support
- Plan digital activity around key events, activations, product launches and company milestones, including pre-, during- and post-event activity.
- Work with customers, partners and internal teams to gather information and assets for campaigns and case studies.
- Support relevant events from a digital marketing perspective, without owning event management or sales activity.

Research & Development
- Research competitors, audiences, digital trends and emerging opportunities.
- Stay up to date with developments across SEO, AEO, GEO, AI, paid advertising and digital marketing technology.
- Identify and recommend new channels, tools and approaches that can improve digital performance and revenue generation.

About You

We're looking for a results-driven, creative and highly organised digital marketer with a strong understanding of digital channels and a genuine passion for delivering measurable results.

Essential Experience & Skills
- 3+ years' digital marketing experience, ideally across both B2 B and B2 C environments.
- Proven experience managing PPC campaigns across Meta and Google Ads.
- Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Premiere Pro.
- Strong knowledge of SEO, GEO and AEO best practices, with experience improving website visibility and rankings.
- Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
- A commercially minded approach, with an understanding of how digital marketing contributes to lead generation, conversion and revenue.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- A genuine passion for and knowledge of sport
- Experience using HubSpot CRM, particularly for marketing automation, campaign management and reporting.
- Basic understanding of UX and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) principles.
- A degree in Marketing or a related subject.
- Experience capturing and editing high-quality visual content, including both video and still photography.

This is an opportunity to join an ambitious business operating at the intersection of sport, technology and innovation.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a broad digital marketing remit, work across multiple brands and have a direct impact on brand visibility, lead generation and commercial growth.

If you're a digital marketer who enjoys being both creative and analytical, is comfortable getting hands-on across multiple channels, and wants to work in an exciting sports technology environment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Media Sales Executive
description:
Media Sales Executive Job in Ferndown

Dovetail Recruitment are proud to be working with a local business that is looking for a Media Sales Executive to join their team in Ferndown. We have personally met with this client, and what is clear is how passionate they are about their business and the local area. They are looking to welcome someone into their small but friendly team to support the next stage of the company's long-term growth.

We are looking for someone like-minded who not only enjoys sales, relationship building, and account management, but who genuinely cares about the Dorset community. This is a role where you'll enjoy the buzz of sales while being rewarded not only through commission, but also through genuine job satisfaction. You'll be the person who is "in the know" about what's happening across Dorset and play a key role in helping local businesses promote themselves effectively.

You will inherit an established client base, meaning you'll have the opportunity to earn commission from day one. You'll also be supported by the wider team, including a dedicated Pre-Press Administrator, allowing you to focus on building relationships, developing accounts, and maximising your earning potential.

Full in-house coaching and training is provided, alongside specialist external media sales training, ensuring you have all the tools and support needed to succeed. Applications are welcomed from candidates at all levels of experience, and part-time hours may be considered for the right person.

What's in it for you?
- Established client base with uncapped commission from day one
- Salary of 28,000 - 30,000 per annum
- OTE of approximately 45,000 - 50,000 (uncapped)
- Working hours: Monday to Thursday, 9.00am - 4.30pm, with a 4.00pm finish on Fridays
- Pension contributions
- Free parking
- 20 days holiday + bank holidays
- Supportive team environment
- Autonomy to make the role your own

Duties and Responsibilities
- Selling media coverage space within high-quality, well-known local magazines and programmes
- Creating and securing sponsorship packages that deliver genuine value for clients
- Promoting digital advertising and social media marketing solutions
- Building strong, long-term relationships with both new and existing advertisers
- Identifying new revenue opportunities and proactively growing client accounts
- Managing and developing an established portfolio of customers

Skills and Experience Required
- A confident communicator with a natural flair for sales
- Previous experience within a sales, account management, or business development role
- Self-motivated, organised, and comfortable working towards targets
- An understanding of how print and digital advertising solutions work together
- A genuine interest in building long-term business relationships
